name: Qube Browser 0.1.13-alpha
notes:
Faster
- The engine is built with LTO and PGO: about 28% quicker, in layout and style
  rather than JavaScript. On its own it now outruns Edge on Speedometer.
- No more logging on every tenth frame, on the thread that draws.

Updates
- Updates install silently -- no setup window.
- A panel in the sidebar says so afterwards, with a link to what changed.
- This window shows release notes, and has room for them.

Fixed
- The command bar no longer opens by itself at launch. Ctrl+T and Ctrl+L still
  open it.
- An Essential's icon follows its tab instead of the site it was pinned from.
- Essentials are drawn on whole pixels at 125% and 175% scaling.
- Lost input and dropped tab commands are recorded instead of vanishing.

Known
- An extension popup takes about a second to appear, longer for some.
summary: Qube is about 28% faster: the engine is now built with link-time and profile-guided optimisation.
